# Attribution

`../compat/include` is a declaration-only Windows/DirectX compatibility header
set copied from the user's MIT-licensed TH08 iOS port (`th08-ios-fix-95`).
Its license is preserved in `TH08-LICENSE`. These declarations help inventory
compiler and layout blockers. They do not implement the TH095 iOS runtime.

The reference TH06/TH07/TH08 working directories are read-only inputs.
